## 9. How to read this

The numbers come from a textual scan (blind spots in the script header). A cycle (Phase 999) runs `report` before and after and compares; CI runs `check`, which holds only the file rule: a file over 500 lines of code that is not in `docs/dev/structure-known.txt`, or a known one that grew, fails. Known files may shrink freely; to record a new exception, edit the file with a reason in the commit.
